headline: Badland Banditos: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Badland Banditos is projected #9 of 16 with a 614.20 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Ja'Marr Chase, Brock Bowers, and Kenneth Walker. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On June 24, Badland Banditos traded with Crimson Tide Pods and acquired Kenneth Walker, 2027 Round 3 (Crimson Tide Pods) while sending Chris Rodriguez, 2026 Round 1 (Corgi Loaf Baking Co.), 2026 Round 1 (All Hail King Jesus). Kenneth Walker is now the current RB starter at 87.3 C-AVI and 86.2 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 1 draft asset.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Jayden Higgins's 50.3 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 56.4 C-AVI would directly attack the 6.10-point projected gap to Southside Savages.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
